mapper.select: SELECT A.ID ,A.CP_ID ,A.CS_ID ,A.RCPT_DT ,A.RCPT_TM ,A.REP_DT ,A.REP_TM ,A.BD_STAT ,A.REG_DT ,A.REG_ID ,A.UPD_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,B.CP_NM FROM TB_CHBD001 A, TB_CHCP001 B WHERE A.CP_ID = B.CP_ID AND ID = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(A.ID) FROM TB_CHBD001 A, TB_CHCP001 B

SELECT A.ID ,A.CP_ID ,A.CS_ID ,A.RCPT_DT ,A.RCPT_TM ,A.REP_DT ,A.REP_TM ,A.BD_STAT ,A.REG_DT ,A.REG_ID ,A.UPD_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,B.CP_NM FROM TB_CHBD001 A, TB_CHCP001 B
ORDER BY A.RCPT_DT DESC, A.RCPT_TM DESC LIMIT #{searchCond.pageItemSize} OFFSET #{searchCond.start}
